scope: Runner execution uses recorded first/last step timestamps, never job started_at alone.
Terminal API updated_at and last job completion are reported separately; neither is silently substituted for an unavailable dedicated workflow completed_at field.
The five-slot policy does not itself demonstrate faster execution or shorter wall time. Waiting categories remain combined or unknown except observed pending/queued/acquired bounds.
